newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Telecom, ITJ to brief media on merger.
newsitem.headline: Japan Telecom, ITJ to brief media on merger.

text.p: Japan Telecom Co Ltd and International Telecoms Japan Inc (ITJ) will hold a news conference at 4.30 p.m. (0730 GMT) on their merger, the companies said on Tuesday.
The presidents of the two companies are expected to attend the news conference.

Japan Telecom, Japan's third-biggest long-distance carrier, and overseas carrier International Telecoms Japan said earlier this month that they were aiming to work out a merger pact by the end of the month.
A merger between Japan Telecom and ITJ would create a company with annual sales of some 400 billion yen.
Japan Telecom told a news conference last week that it has hopes for further tie-ups in the future, including one with Japan's top international carrier Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD).
